program = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height, width = len(out), len(out[0])
    gaps = []
    # Complete one-cell breaks within horizontal runs.
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(1, width - 1):
            color = out[r][c - 1]
            if color != 0 and out[r][c] == 0 and out[r][c + 1] == color:
                out[r][c] = color
                gaps.append((r, c, color))
    # Each completed break extends upward, stopping at the next colored cell.
    for r, c, color in gaps:
        rr = r - 1
        while rr >= 0 and out[rr][c] == 0:
            out[rr][c] = color
            rr -= 1
    return out
'''

program = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height, width = len(out), len(out[0])
    gaps = []
    # Complete one-cell breaks within horizontal runs.
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(1, width - 1):
            color = out[r][c - 1]
            if color != 0 and out[r][c] == 0 and out[r][c + 1] == color:
                out[r][c] = color
                gaps.append((r, c, color))
    # Horizontal bars project their color upward through empty cells.
    for r, c, color in gaps:
        rr = r - 1
        while rr >= 0 and out[rr][c] == 0:
            out[rr][c] = color
            rr -= 1
    # Vertical marker bars below the horizontal lines project upward as well.
    for c in range(width):
        r = height - 1
        while r >= 0:
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                r -= 1
                continue
            color = out[r][c]
            top = r
            while top > 0 and out[top - 1][c] == color:
                top -= 1
            length = r - top + 1
            if length >= 2 or r >= height - 2:
                rr = top - 1
                while rr >= 0 and out[rr][c] == 0:
                    out[rr][c] = color
                    rr -= 1
            r = top - 1
    return out
'''
